The '''Si'Klaata Cluster''' was a [[star cluster]] in [[Hutt Space]]. It contained the [[planet]] [[Vodran]], which was once ruled by [[Harra]] the [[Hutt]].<ref name="Escape from Vodran" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Si'Klaata Cluster was originally created for the 1995 [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] roleplaying supplement ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', published by [[West End Games]]. The location became canon when it was included in the [[2017]] children's book ''[[Join the Resistance]]''.
